# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: UAE 1970 politics effects — scripted effects.
## COLDWAR | UAE 1970 native politics. Generated by tools/uae_1970/politics.py.

COLDWAR_UAE_apply_starting_politics = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes }
		set_country_flag = IMP_1970_historical_politics
		set_popularities = { democratic = 61 communism = 4 fascism = 2 neutrality = 22 nationalist = 11 }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = no }
		start_politics_input = yes
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^0 = 0.54 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^1 = 0.07 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^4 = 0.02 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^7 = 0.02 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^10 = 0.02 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^13 = 0.11 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^14 = 0.07 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^18 = 0.04 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^22 = 0.06 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^23 = 0.05 }
		set_variable = { ruling_party = 0 }
		set_party_name = { ideology = democratic name = COLDWAR_UAE_party_0 long_name = COLDWAR_UAE_party_0 }
		startup_politics = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_startup_pre_economy = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign
		COLDWAR_UAE_startup_industry = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				date < 1970.1.3
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_low_oil_bootstrapped }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_1970_gdp_profile_applied }
				owns_state = 179 controls_state = 179 owns_state = 180 controls_state = 180
			}
			# Canonical resources are Dubai7 and AbuDhabi40. Reduce once before the
			# native economic startup and its frozen 0.686bn GDP accounting offset.
			179 = { add_resource = { type = oil amount = -6 } }
			180 = { add_resource = { type = oil amount = -37 } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_low_oil_bootstrapped
		}
		# GDP counts office/civilian productivity and workforce fulfillment. Install
		# the approved starting difficulties before native setup and its once-frozen
		# historical accounting offset, regardless of on_startup file merge order.
		COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_politics_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_politics_initialised } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_politics_initialised
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_UAE_president } }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 0 }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_UAE_politics_sync = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_set_monarchist_leader = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { MDCW_HP_native_retirement = 1 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire }
				date < 1990.10.7
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 0 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 1 } }
			else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 0 } }
		}
		# Rashid's alternate presidency cannot survive his death. Later historical
		# successors prevent an indefinitely extended 1970 campaign resurrecting him.
		if = { limit = { date > 1990.10.6 check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 1 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { date > 2004.11.1 } set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { date > 2022.5.12 } set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 3 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 0 } }
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/mohammed_bin_zayed_al_nahyan.dds"
				ideology = Western_Autocracy
				traits = { king western_Western_Autocracy }
			}
		}

		else = {
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/mohammed_bin_zayed_al_nahyan.dds"
				ideology = Monarchist
				traits = { king nationalist_Monarchist }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 0 } }
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/khalifa_bin_zayed_al_nahyan.dds"
				ideology = Western_Autocracy
				traits = { king western_Western_Autocracy }
			}
		}

		else = {
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/khalifa_bin_zayed_al_nahyan.dds"
				ideology = Monarchist
				traits = { king nationalist_Monarchist }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 0 } }
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/UAE_rashid_bin_saeed_al_maktoum.dds"
				ideology = Western_Autocracy
				traits = { king western_Western_Autocracy }
			}
		}

		else = {
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/UAE_rashid_bin_saeed_al_maktoum.dds"
				ideology = Monarchist
				traits = { king nationalist_Monarchist }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 0 } }
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/zayed_bin_sultan_al_nahyan.dds"
				ideology = Western_Autocracy
				traits = { king western_Western_Autocracy }
			}
		}

		else = {
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/zayed_bin_sultan_al_nahyan.dds"
				ideology = Monarchist
				traits = { king nationalist_Monarchist }
			}
		}
	}
	}
	else = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 0 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Trucial States Council"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/UAE_Coldwar_Trucial_States_Council.dds"
			ideology = Western_Autocracy
			traits = { western_Western_Autocracy }
		}
	}

	else = {
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Trucial States Council"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/UAE_Coldwar_Trucial_States_Council.dds"
			ideology = Monarchist
			traits = { nationalist_Monarchist }
		}
	}

	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_set_leader = {
	if = {
	limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_supported_government = yes }
	kill_country_leader = yes
	update_set_politics = yes
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_monarchy_government = yes }
		COLDWAR_UAE_set_monarchist_leader = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Constitutional Conservative Cabinet"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/UAE_Coldwar_Trucial_States_Council.dds"
			ideology = conservatism
			traits = {  }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Constitutional Liberal Cabinet"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/UAE_Coldwar_Trucial_States_Council.dds"
			ideology = liberalism
			traits = {  }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "National Planning Council"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/UAE_Coldwar_Trucial_States_Council.dds"
			ideology = communist_state
			traits = {  }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 7 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Civic Arab Government"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/UAE_Coldwar_Trucial_States_Council.dds"
			ideology = Autocracy
			traits = {  }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 12 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Association Reform Cabinet"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/UAE_Coldwar_Trucial_States_Council.dds"
			ideology = Neutral_Muslim_Brotherhood
			traits = {  }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Social Coalition Cabinet"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/UAE_Coldwar_Trucial_States_Council.dds"
			ideology = neutral_Social
			traits = {  }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Federal Officers Council"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/UAE/UAE_Coldwar_Trucial_States_Council.dds"
			ideology = Nat_Autocracy
			traits = {  }
		}
	}
	set_correct_ideology_trait = yes
	COLDWAR_UAE_sync_offices = yes
	COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_sync_offices = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_zayed_president
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_rashid_president
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_cabinet_active
		if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan" ruling_only = yes } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_zayed_president }
		if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum" ruling_only = yes } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_rashid_president }
		# Cabinet offices are status ideas, with no independent bonus. Political
		# programme spending and relief remain in the approved common ledger.
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_monarchy_government = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_cabinet_settled date < 1990.10.7 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_rashid_president } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_cabinet_active
				if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_maktoum } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_maktoum }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_rashid } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_rashid }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_rashid } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_rashid }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_maktoum } date < 2006.1.4 } add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_maktoum }
				if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_maktoum date > 2006.1.3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_maktoum }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_maktoum } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_maktoum }
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_rashid } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_prime_minister_rashid }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_politics_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_supported_government = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 0 }
			if = { limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_monarchy_government = yes }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 0 } NOT = { has_country_leader_with_trait = western_Western_Autocracy } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 23 } NOT = { has_country_leader_with_trait = nationalist_Monarchist } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Trucial States Council" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_UAE_president } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { date > 1990.10.6 check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 1 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { date > 2004.11.1 check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president < 2 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 2 } }
				if = { limit = { date > 2022.5.12 check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president < 3 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 3 } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 2 } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 1 } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 0 } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Constitutional Conservative Cabinet" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Constitutional Liberal Cabinet" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "National Planning Council" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 7 } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Civic Arab Government" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 12 } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Association Reform Cabinet" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Social Coalition Cabinet" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 } NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Federal Officers Council" ruling_only = yes } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_needs_leader = 1 } } COLDWAR_UAE_set_leader = yes }
		}
		COLDWAR_UAE_sync_offices = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_politics_tick = {
	COLDWAR_UAE_politics_sync = yes
}

COLDWAR_UAE_form_federation = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes is_subject = no has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_sovereign_union has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_proclaim_federation has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_founders_consented NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_established
		# A real sovereign union creates the federal offices, never a calendar expiry.
		drop_cosmetic_tag = yes
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_president = 0 }
		COLDWAR_UAE_politics_sync = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_convene_constitution = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_constitutional_convention } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_constitutional_convention
		set_politics = { elections_allowed = yes election_frequency = 48 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^0 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^7 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^18 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^22 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^23 = 0 }
	update_dirty_politicsview_expanded = yes
	COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_organise_association = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_islah_organised } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_islah_organised
		set_variable = { party_banned_array^12 = 0 }
		update_dirty_politicsview_expanded = yes
		COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_accept_cabinet_bargain = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes COLDWAR_UAE_monarchy_government = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_federation_formed }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_cabinet_settled
		COLDWAR_UAE_sync_offices = yes
		COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_establish_dirham = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_dirham_established } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_dirham_established
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_dirham_currency
		set_variable = { no_foreign_reserve = 1 }
		calculate_reserve_roi_bonus = yes
		refresh_currency_inflation_effects = yes
	}
}
